text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT NOTICE: High request spike and elevated 5xx/429s for org Argosys (org_id: org_8347). Pager routed to oncall.
pagerduty: @morgan oncall-sre paged for P0 - org spike
morgan: I'm on it. What's the customer impact? Any degraded latency or increased errors on their prod traffic?
support-alyssa: They're reporting increasing 429s and some client-side retries. Support dashboard shows org_8347 experiencing 70-90% 429 rate on their /v1/generate route over last 8m. A handful of key customers are timing out.
eng-runtime-james: Checked runtime metrics — sustained QPS for org_8347 ~1.1k, 95th latency backoff rising, and per-org token budget exhausted triggering org-level quota gate.
teja: Confirmed logs: `quota_check: org=org_8347 used_tokens=125000 limit_tokens_per_min=6000 => blocking`. So the org hit a burst threshold.
morgan: We need an emergency mitigation now: two-pronged — (1) temporarily lower org QPS cap to limit the blast radius; (2) disable streaming for that org to reduce concurrent KV/cache pressure. Any objections?
eng-runtime-james: Agree. Lowering QPS to a soft cap reduces request fanout and keeps other customers safe. Streaming disable will reduce connection churn. We'll also watch autoscaler.
product-ops-anya: If we throttle aggressively, product might see degraded UX. Coordinate with support to message the account.
morgan: I'm going to apply a temporary rate cap: target QPS 300 for 60 minutes. Running admin command now.
teja: Run it in staging first? We need to be quick — this is causing cross-tenant slowness.
morgan: Doing prod change with a safety TTL. Command:
```
# internal admin tool
rbctl org-rate set --org org_8347 --qps 300 --burst 400 --duration 60m --reason "emergency spike mitigation 1992345678"
```
ops-bot: Executing: rbctl org-rate set --org org_8347 --qps 300 --burst 400 --duration 60m
ops-bot: SUCCESS: org rate updated. previous_qps=1200 previous_burst=1600 new_qps=300 new_burst=400 ttl=3600s
support-alyssa: Notifying account team (cc @billing-lia). Will tell them we applied a temporary cap to protect platform availability and will offer credits if needed.
billing-lia: Acknowledged; please include estimated request reduction and duration so we can prepare pro-rated credit if the customer requests.
eng-runtime-james: Next, will disable streaming for that org to cut down on KV cache memory pressure.
morgan: Approving. Command:
```
rbctl org-feature disable --org org_8347 --feature streaming --reason "reduce concurrent kernel pressure during spike"
```
ops-bot: Executing: rbctl org-feature disable --org org_8347 --feature streaming
ops-bot: SUCCESS: feature "streaming" disabled for org_8347. Will take effect within 15s for new sessions.
teja: Observability: within 2m of changes, 429 rate dropped from ~82% -> ~18% and downstream 5xx reduced. QPS for org is now ~280. Monitoring dashboards attached: <https://metrics.internal/redwood/d/orga-org_8347>
morgan: Good mitigation. Keep watches on latency and error budget. @eng-runtime-james can you keep an eye on autoscaler and memory pressure for next 30m?
eng-runtime-james: Watching. Not seeing autoscaler thrash; GPU pools healthy. Memory pressure on the KV nodes dropped ~40% after streaming disable.
product-ops-anya: Support will send a short templated note to the account with rollback ETA and next steps.
support-alyssa: Sent message to account team and primary customer contacts. Provided explanation + we offered to remove cap early if their traffic is redelivered more gracefully.
morgan: We're moving to a formal handoff: teja, you'll monitor for next 45m and escalate if error rate rises >10% or latency 95p increases 50ms. I'll take postmortem ownership.
teja: Oncall ack. I'll escalate to infra if we see any autoscaler anomalies.
eng-runtime-james: Action item: after traffic normalizes, we'll run a quick analysis to see whether increasing per-org soft limits or adding smoother token-bucket parameters helps.
morgan: Also create follow-up runbook note and include exact rbctl commands and decision rationale.
ops-bot: Note created: incident/1992345678-argosys-temp-throttle (internal tracker)
support-alyssa: Customer reports partial recovery in their region; still some retries but overall success rate improving.
billing-lia: Flagging for potential credit — will hold until postmortem.
morgan: Closing active mitigation — we'll let the TTL expire and then do controlled rollback rather than removing immediately. If Argosys requests early rollback, we need a paired mitigation (gradual ramp + monitoring).
eng-runtime-james: Postmortem checklist: collect org token histograms, kernel pressure logs, autoscaler events, and timeline of rbctl changes.
product-ops-anya: I'll arrange an account call after the PM has the initial RCA.
morgan: Thanks team. Handoff complete to teja for 45m watch. If anyone sees a regression, ping #incidents with @oncall.
teja: Watching now. :eyes:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: immediate threat mitigated. Root cause investigation in progress. #postmortem will be scheduled.
